Sequential Verifiable Delay Functions gate entry: every new identity must finish a chain of 1024 sequential steps before earning one credential. Each step seeds the next, so a thousand fake runs its own 16,384 core-cycles. A farm of N clones pays N times the base compute in raw cycles, while one honest agent pays once. No discount, no parallel shortcut: dependency chains forbid splitting, sharing, or prefetching. Detected clusters forfeit seed and face a 20-epoch ban, losing vouching.

Like a dune trapping the orchard, a tundra cannot be farmed unless every worker knocks on every door.
